network.name: electricvehicle
network.description: Fire-risk Bayesian network for electric vehicles, with component failures, environmental/human factors and intermediate ignition events. Based on the electricvehicle network documented in bnRep and Chen, Li and Yang (2022).
network.temporal_context: No specific time horizon is stipulated in this input.
network.measurement_context: Discrete binary event indicators; yes/no labels are retained, placed in risk-increasing order no to yes for the Ranked Nodes algorithm.
network.notes: The file includes nodes, their descriptions, binary states and directed edges only. It deliberately omits all original conditional probability tables. Before quantitative evaluation, check edges using the accompanying R verification script against the bnRep package version used to export the gold network.

nodes.name: ACF

states.name: no
states.meaning: The event ACF is absent / does not occur.

states.name: yes
states.meaning: The event ACF is present / occurs.

nodes.temporal_context: Occurrence of the event within the modeled electric-vehicle fire scenario; no fixed time horizon specified.
nodes.measurement_context: Binary event (no/yes). Ordered no < yes for Ranked Nodes as absence to occurrence; this is a modeling assumption, not the bnRep variable-class declaration.
nodes.notes: Evaluate occurrence probability for this binary risk/failure event; the network contains no original CPT probabilities.
